data.name: Sumaiya
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'suhma' meaning 'moon'. Sumaiya signifies tranquility, calmness, and peace. This name is mentioned in the Quran and Hadith as the name of a female companion of the Prophet Muhammad.

in_urdu.name: سمية
